get.description:
Returns a list of alerts that your account has access to.
Alerts are listed in reverse chronological order by default.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: A field by which the results will be sorted.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
An expression for filtering the results. The syntax is `key:[<value>]`. Multiple filters can be connected using a pipe |. See [Filters](https://developer.doit.com/docs/filters).
Available filter keys: **owner**, **name**

get.description: Returns an alert by the specified Id.

delete.description: Deletes the alert specified by the Id.

patch.description: Updates the alert specified by the Id.

get.description:
Returns a list of allocations that your account has access to.
Allocations are listed in reverse chronological order by default.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
An expression for filtering the results.
Valid fields: **type**, **owner**, **name**, **folderId**.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: A field by which the results will be sorted.

pageToken.description: Page token, returned by a previous call, to request the next page of results.

rowCount.description: Total number of allocations in the result set.

400.description: \u003Ctable\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Cth\u003EError Code\u003C/th\u003E\u003Cth\u003EDescription\u003C/th\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eamount_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe amounts specified in the charge are not equal to the sum of the amounts in charge details\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ebuyer_currency_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe specified currency is not matched with buyer currency\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ebuyer_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe buyer on the Credit charge does not match the buyer of the referenced Sale charge identified by previous_charge_id. The Credit charge must be issued by the same buyer as the original Sale charge\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ecannot_override_payment_terms\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe charge_payment_days needs to be a valid value and the buyer must not be consolidated\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Echarge_credit_is_not_supported\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe charge type of credit is not supported\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ecurrency_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe currency of the Credit charge does not match the currency of the referenced Sale charge via previous_charge_id\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Edetail_amount_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe amounts specified in the charge details are not equal to the subtotal of the detail in charge details\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Edeferred_processing_not_allowed\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThis program is not configured to allow deferred processing\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ediscount_amount_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe discount amount specified in the charge is not equal to the sum of the discount amount in charge details\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eduplicate_charge_id\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe provided id already exists. Use a unique charge ID\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_authorization\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EInvalid authorization for the ID specified\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_buyer\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EBuyer does not exist or inactive\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_card_number\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ECard for the given card number does not exist, is inactive, or has expired\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_card_service_card_id\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ECard for the given card service card ID does not exist, is inactive, or has expired\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_card_token\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ECard for the given card token does not exist, is inactive, or has expired\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_charge_details_tax_details\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EInvalid charge.details.tax_details were supplied.\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_country\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid country code in the company address\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_amount_for_credit\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe total_amount specified for the credit transaction exceeds the remaining uncredited amount of the original charge. Credit amounts must be less than or equal to the uncredited portion of the referenced Sale charge\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_customer_group_id\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe customer_group_id that was provided is not associated with the buyer or does not exist\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_input\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EOne of the request inputs is not valid\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_po\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EPurchase Order number is invalid or does not match expected format\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_po_format\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EPurchase Order number format does not match policy rules\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_po_not_unique\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EPurchase Order number is not unique\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_program\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ESeller and Buyer are not in the same program\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_previous_charge_id\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe provided previous_charge_id is invalid. Ensure it is a correctly formatted UUID and references an existing charge in the system. When creating a Credit charge, the previous_charge_id must reference an existing Sale charge that is in a creditable state (e.g., status is not Rejected, Cancelled or Pending Payment)\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_request_error\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EAn unhandled error was received from the payment provider. See the `message` field for details.\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_seller\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ESeller for the given ID does not exist or inactive\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvalid_shipping_amount\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EShipping amount + shipping tax amount - shipping discount amount cannot be less than 0\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Einvoice_insured_auth_requires_preauthorization\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EWhen program.insured_auth_enabled is true, invoice can only be created with a preauthorization that has is_insured set to true\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Emissing_program\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe associated Program was not found\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Epo_required\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EPurchase Order number is required\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Epricing_errors\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EOne or more of the charge details has a pricing validation error. Please check the response for specific details regarding the error\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eprogram_credit_limit_exceeded\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ECredit charge exceeds the maximum allowed for this program.\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Erequire_authorization\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EA valid authorization must be provided with the charge due to the requirement set on your program\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Erequire_card_verification_value\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ecard_verification_value is required when the charge does not have a valid authorization and is_card_present = false\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Erequire_charge_details_tax_details\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe invoice country require charge.details.tax_details\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Erequire_is_card_present\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eis_card_present is required when the charge does not have a valid authorization\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Erequire_item_code\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EWhen pricing is enabled, charge.details.item_code is required\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Erequire_shipping_tax_details\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe invoice country require charge.details.tax_details\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eseller_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe seller on the Credit charge does not match the seller of the referenced Sale charge identified by previous_charge_id.  Or the provided buyer and seller combination is invalid.\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eshipping_tax_amount_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe shipping tax amount specified in the charge is not equal to the sum of the tax amount in shipping tax details.\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Etax_amount_mismatch\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe tax amount specified in the charge is not equal to the sum of the tax amount in charge details\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eunsupported_currency\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe specified currency is not supported for the seller\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Eunsupported_operation\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EThe operation needs to be enabled for the program\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Evalidation.body_not_matching_json_schema\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003ERequest body failed JSON schema validation. The `validationErrors` property contain information regarding which parts of the payload not passing validation.\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Evalidation.unsupported_media_type\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EUnsupported media type\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ewithhold_seller_amount_too_large\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ewithhold_seller_amount is greater than the charge total_amount\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003Ctr\u003E\u003Ctd\u003Ewithhold_seller_amount_not_supported\u003C/td\u003E\u003Ctd\u003EWithholding seller amounts is not supported for this program\u003C/td\u003E\u003C/tr\u003E \u003C/table\u003E\n

scopes.description: The filters that define the scope of the alert. Each item is a Cloud Analytics filter (same idea as report filters). evaluateForEach.description: Add a dimension to break down the evaluation of the condition. For example, evaluate a condition over an attribution for each "Service". AllocationComponent.description:
A filter component used inside allocation rules.
When the type is "allocation_rule", the component references existing allocation rules (nested allocation rules).
A maximum nesting depth of 3 levels is supported, and circular references are not allowed.

key.description:
Key of an existing dimension. Examples: "billing_account_id", "country". When type is "allocation_rule", the key must be set to "allocation_rule".
Use `GET /analytics/v1/dimensions` to retrieve all available dimensions.

values.description: Values to filter on. When type is "allocation_rule", the values are IDs of existing allocation rules.

inverse.description: If true, all selected values will be excluded.

inverse_selection.description: If true, all selected values will be excluded.
